description: Source code for a test suite that reads and executes cryptographic big number tests from a file, including parsing test data, performing calculations, and validating results.

classes.name: test
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic test case with line number, type, and associated big number values.

classes.name: testScanner
classes.description: Encapsulates scanning and parsing of test data from an input reader, maintaining state and errors.

methods.name: newTestScanner
methods.description: Creates a new testScanner instance from an io.Reader.

methods.name: scanLine
methods.description: Advances the scanner to the next line, updating line number.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Parses a line into a key-value attribute, updating test values.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Reads and parses a complete test case from input.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Returns the current parsed test case.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns any error encountered during scanning.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error with line number context.
